spots.name: Lake Tiak-O' Khata
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Little Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 180 m (591 ft).
